description: Timetabled bus departures at one stop, from the Bus Open Data (BODS) timetables. Pass `stop` (the NaPTAN ATCO code `nearby_stops` returns), optional `at` (RFC 3339, default now; the index holds three service days from today), `window_minutes` (1 to 180, default 60) and `limit` (1 to 30, default 8). Each departure carries `line`, `destination`, `operator`, `scheduled_at` (local time) and `trip`, plus `live` when a vehicle on that line was seen in the live positions within 3 km and heading towards the stop (`vehicle`, `distance_m`, `age_s`). These are TIMETABLE times: `basis` is always "timetable", and a live entry is an observation, never an arrival time or a delay. MapMap does not predict arrivals: never present `scheduled_at` or `live` as one, and pass on the returned `label` and `coverage` verbatim. Requires the MapMap gateway; a deployment without the departures index answers a clear error. Display the returned `attribution` (NaPTAN and BODS, Open Government Licence v3.0).

at.description:
Start of the window, RFC 3339 (e.g. "2026-10-12T08:00:00+01:00");
default now. The index holds three service days from today.

stop.description: The stop's NaPTAN ATCO code, as `nearby_stops` returns it.

name: next_departures

live.description:
A vehicle on this line seen heading towards the stop, or absent.
An observation, never an arrival time.

scheduled_at.description:
The timetabled departure, RFC 3339 in local time. A timetable time,
never a prediction.

TransitLiveOut.description: A vehicle seen on the departure's line heading towards the stop.

age_s.description: Age of the vehicle's position fix, seconds.

distance_m.description: Straight-line distance from the vehicle to the stop, metres.

bearing_deg.description:
Bearing from the queried point to the stop, degrees clockwise from
true north.

distance_m.description: Straight-line distance from the queried point, metres.

id.description:
The NaPTAN ATCO code, e.g. "490008660N": pass it to
`next_departures`.

lines.description: Line names the timetable has calling at the stop.

attribution.description: NaPTAN and BODS attribution (Open Government Licence v3.0).

coverage.description: What the data covers. Pass it on with the departures.

generated_at.description: When the answer was assembled, RFC 3339.

label.description:
The honesty line, verbatim: timetable times, what a live entry is,
and that MapMap does not predict arrival times. Pass it on with the
departures.

timetable_date.description: The service date the requested time falls on, YYYY-MM-DD.
